messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 45(5)

Article 45 Compliant products within the scope of this Regulation which present a risk. 5. The Commission shall address its decision to all Member States and shall immediately communicate it to them and to the relevant economic operator or operators.

response.text:
The Commission | addressesDecision | its decision to all Member States | for compliant products within the scope of this Regulation which present a risk | The Commission shall address its decision to all Member States
The Commission | communicatesDecision | its decision to the Member States immediately | for compliant products within the scope of this Regulation which present a risk | shall immediately communicate it to them
The Commission | communicatesDecision | its decision to the relevant economic operator or operators immediately | for compliant products within the scope of this Regulation which present a risk | shall immediately communicate it to them and to the relevant economic operator or operators
